body.heading: Where in the world is Algeria?
paragraphs: Algeria is a country in Northern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Algeria is Algiers.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Algeria is Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Algeria is the Algerian dinar.

body.heading: How big is Algeria?
paragraphs: Algeria covers about 2,382,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. It is the largest country in Africa. That makes it about three times the size of Mozambique.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Casbah is the old hillside heart of Algiers, a maze of whitewashed lanes and palaces above the Mediterranean Sea that families can explore with a guide.
Algeria holds a huge share of the Sahara. Around the oasis town of Timimoun, red sand dunes roll to the horizon and palm groves hide old mud-brick villages.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Algeria on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
